results.summary:
`/kanban:specify` and `/kanban:decompose` are now real slash commands instead of section titles that looked like ones. Took option 1 from the card (make them real), not option 2.

**One source, two registrations.** `commands/specify.md` and `commands/decompose.md` at the package root are (a) the plugin's command directory — `"commands": "./commands"` in `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, plus `commands` added to `files` in package.json — and (b) what `hkb init` now copies into `.claude/commands/kanban/` for everyone who installs from npm without the plugin. Both produce the same name: a plugin namespaces its commands by plugin name, a project namespaces them by directory, and both are `kanban`. In hkb's own repo init links instead of copying (`.claude/commands/kanban → ../../commands`), same reasoning as `.agents/skills/kanban`; `installCommands()` in `src/init.js` picks link-or-copy off `isPackageRepo()`, and `linkSkill` was refactored onto a shared `linkDir()`.

**The bodies delegate.** Each command file sends the reader to the `SKILL.md` section of the same name, so the procedure has one home. SKILL.md now says where the commands come from and what a harness without slash commands (Copilot, Codex) should do instead — ask for the section by name. Skill `metadata.version` 0.4.0 → 0.5.0 so `hkb doctor` tells an existing adopter their copy is behind; `test/track.test.js` pins that version and was updated with it.

**Three guards, each aimed at a different way this returns.** `commands/*.md` in `MUST_SHIP` and the init-written copies in `FROM_PACKAGE` (`scripts/smoke-pack.mjs`), so a `files` regression fails CI. A test that scrapes every `/kanban:*` out of the installed SKILL.md and asserts the set equals the set of files that ship — add a name to the skill without a file and `npm test` fails. And `checkCommands()` in `src/doctor.js`, which warns with `hkb init` as the fix in a repo where they were never installed.

**The "also check" audit came back clean.** Every `hkb <verb>` and every flag named in the shipped skill, `references/protocol.md` and the generated doc sections exists in `src/cli.js`. One thing left deliberately: SKILL.md's aside that dispatcher changes are tested with `node --test test/dispatch.test.js` names a file adopters do not have — but it explains why not to run `hkb dispatch` rather than instructing an action, and only fires for someone editing hkb itself. Also noted, not changed: `templates/copilot/kanban-worker.agent.md` splices the whole SKILL.md body, so a Copilot worker's agent file carries the two `/kanban:*` sections; the new SKILL.md sentence about harnesses with no slash commands makes that generated file honest without forking the text.

**Not done here:** nothing. The PR is a draft (#94) awaiting the operator's review and merge, per board policy.
